verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST API with personal access token (bearer) authentication and endpoints to list, create, and cancel events and to update links. This lets scripts or CI jobs drive the product programmatically without the UI. However, there is no documented CLI, CI integration, or headless-mode guidance, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline documentation or examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The SavvyCal API adheres to REST conventions. Our API communicates in JSON format and uses OAuth access tokens to authenticate requests.
To try it out on your own account, create a personal access token.
Personal access token authentication ... Bearer format: pt_secret_XXXXXXXXX
List events GET /v1/events ... Cancel event POST /v1/events/{event_id}/cancel ... Create event POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events
